description: Refined 13-Shot (Phase 10/12). Baseline for Flash (F1~0.75). Use gemini-3-pro-preview for Production (F1~0.85).

examples.label: Positive Example 3E: Mound on Green Background (Vegetation). Note the symbol is the same despite the background color.
Positive Example 3F: Obscured/Intersected Mound. The mound symbol persists even when cut by roads, rivers, or black lines.
Positive Example 3G: Compound Symbol (Mound + Triangulation Point). The mound rays surround the central triangle.
Negative Example 2: Sparse Area (Contours + Roads only). NO MOUNDS.
Negative Example 3: Complex Topography/River. NO MOUNDS.
Negative Example 4: Urban/Cluttered Area. Buildings are not mounds. NO MOUNDS.
Negative Example 5: Embankment/Depression. Note the rays point INWARD (concave), unlike a mound (convex). NO MOUNDS.
Negative Example 6: Isolated Benchmark. A square with a dot is NOT a mound. NO MOUNDS.
Negative Example 7: Isolated Triangulation Point. A triangle with a dot (without surrounding rays) is NOT a mound. NO MOUNDS.
